request.query: Linearly independent polynomials have nonzero determinant of successive Hasse derivatives

items.name: Matrix.linearIndependent_rows_of_det_ne_zero
items.type:
∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  {A : Matrix m m R}, A.det ≠ 0 → LinearIndependent R fun i => A i

items.name: Matrix.linearIndependent_cols_of_det_ne_zero
items.type:
∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  {A : Matrix m m R}, A.det ≠ 0 → LinearIndependent R A.col

items.name: Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_not_linearIndependent_rows
items.type:
∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  {A : Matrix m m R}, (¬LinearIndependent R fun i => A i) → A.det = 0

items.name: Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_not_linearIndependent_cols
items.type:
∀ {m : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  {A : Matrix m m R}, (¬LinearIndependent R fun i => A.transpose i) → A.det = 0

items.name: Matrix.det_mvPolynomialX_ne_zero
items.type:
∀ (m : Type u_1) (R : Type u_3) [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] [inst_2 : CommRing R] [Nontrivial R],
  (Matrix.mvPolynomialX m m R).det ≠ 0

items.name: Polynomial.det_taylorLinearEquiv
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {r : R} {n : ℕ}, LinearEquiv.det (Polynomial.taylorLinearEquiv r n) = 1

items.name: Algebra.discr_zero_of_not_linearIndependent
items.type:
∀ (A : Type u) {B : Type v} {ι : Type w} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : CommRing B]
  [inst_3 : Algebra A B] [inst_4 : Fintype ι] [IsDomain A] {b : ι → B}, ¬LinearIndependent A b → Algebra.discr A b = 0

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R
